description: Implementation of time-related functions for Windows, including gettimeofday and clock_gettime, with cross-platform considerations.

methods.name: gettimeofday
methods.description: Retrieves the current time of day, converting Windows system time to Unix epoch time.

methods.name: clock_gettime
methods.description: Provides clock time for CLOCK_REALTIME and CLOCK_MONOTONIC clocks on Windows.

methods.name: gmtime_r
methods.description: Thread-safe version of gmtime, converting time_t to tm structure.
